projects.name: BK – São José dos Campos

clientData.oir: Standardized restaurant-portfolio data for facility management and brand compliance across all units.
clientData.pir: Coordinated, clash-free design enabling permit, tender and construction of the standard BK prototype on schedule and budget.
clientData.air: As-built structural / hydraulic / MEP data + equipment register (COBie-style) for operation & maintenance at handover.
clientData.brand: Burger King Global Design & Image Standards (brand book) + local prototype kit.

permits.notes: Municipal — São José dos Campos (target with M4)

projects.desc: New-build drive-thru Burger King restaurant (~380 m² GFA), single-story, steel frame + concrete slab-on-grade; kitchen, dining area, drive-thru lane and parking. BIM scope: structural, foundations, hydraulic and HVAC modeling and coordination on the BK prototype.

contract.payment: 20% on appointment; balance tied to milestones M2–M5

coords.cadastral: SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 23S (EPSG:31983); base point from topographic survey

risks.mitigation: Freeze dates + change log; version control
Request early; work with preliminary assumptions
Weekly coordination; clash review per milestone

cde.notes: WIP internal; Shared = for coordination; Published = approved for construction only. Manager = Information Manager.

federation.notes: Shared coordinates / common origin agreed (SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 23S).

bimUses.purpose: Site & existing-conditions model from survey

Federation + clash detection across disciplines

Multidiscipline review + BCF issues
